aboutThisLitter: Honey and Bram are producing a special litter of Multigen Micro Goldendoodles with the compact size, soft coats, and affectionate temperaments families love.
Honey is a micro Goldendoodle mama with a gentle, people-oriented personality and beautiful red-chocolate coloring. Bram brings a confident, playful temperament that balances Honey's calm sweetness.
These puppies are expected to stay in the 10-15 pound full-grown range, making them a strong fit for families wanting a smaller companion without sacrificing temperament or coat quality.
We expect rich apricot, red, red-chocolate, and caramel tones with straight to slightly wavy coats that are silky soft and low shedding.

aboutTitle: A tiny F1B Cavapoo pairing with sweet companion temperaments.
aboutThisLitter: Penny and Wyatt have produced a beautiful litter of F1B Micro Cavapoos with soft coats, joyful temperaments, and classic companion-dog sweetness.

Penny is a lovely F1 Cavapoo weighing around 25 pounds with a red and white parti coat and a gentle, people-oriented personality. Wyatt is a tiny 4 pound toy Poodle who brings confidence, intelligence, and affectionate temperament to this pairing.
These puppies are expected to mature to approximately 10 to 18 pounds full grown, placing them in the micro Cavapoo range.

Coats are expected to be soft, silky, and wavy, with red, apricot, and red and white parti coloring possible throughout the litter. With the stronger Poodle influence, these puppies should have minimal to very low shedding.
We expect this litter to be sweet, intelligent, eager to please, and well suited for families wanting a small, people-focused companion.
